items.title: Surjectivity onto each one-generator completion implies surjectivity onto the ideal-adic completion
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file algebra.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: For a finitely generated ideal I = (f_1, ..., f_r) the lemma states that if M surjects onto each completion with respect to a single generator, then M surjects onto the I-adic completion (statement lines 22972-22977). The proof does not argue with the I-adic filtration directly: it replaces it by the filtration cut out by the separate powers of the generators, using I^n contained in (f_1^n, ..., f_r^n) contained in I^{rn}, writes an element of the resulting limit as a symbolic series in the f_i, and matches the series term by term using the hypotheses for the individual generators (proof lines 22979-22990). The substitution of one tower by the other is the step that makes the term-by-term matching possible. H2.
